expected_behavior: A saga compensation declared for a trigger event after another event must be enabled only when both event flags are true. Both the rendered-kernel path and direct AST-lowering path must add the after-event guard before writing emitted-event state.
fix_patch:
diff --git a/rust/fsl-core/src/domain.rs b/rust/fsl-core/src/domain.rs
--- a/rust/fsl-core/src/domain.rs
+++ b/rust/fsl-core/src/domain.rs
@@ -850,6 +850,10 @@ fn render_saga_actions(context: &Context<'_>, saga: &DomainSaga) -> Vec<String>
             "  requires {}",
             Context::event_flag(&compensation.trigger_event)
         ));
+        lines.push(format!(
+            "  requires {}",
+            Context::event_flag(&compensation.after_event)
+        ));
         lines.extend(
             event_assignments(context.domain, &compensation.emits)
                 .into_iter()
diff --git a/rust/fsl-core/src/domain_lowering.rs b/rust/fsl-core/src/domain_lowering.rs
--- a/rust/fsl-core/src/domain_lowering.rs
+++ b/rust/fsl-core/src/domain_lowering.rs
@@ -1772,10 +1772,17 @@ fn lower_saga_actions(
             resolver.event(&compensation.trigger_event, compensation.loc)?;
             resolver.event(&compensation.after_event, compensation.loc)?;
             let span = span_at(compensation.loc);
-            let mut action_items = vec![ActionItem::Requires(
-                Expr::Var(event_flag(&compensation.trigger_event)),
-                span,
-            )];
+            let mut action_items = vec![
+                ActionItem::Requires(
+                    Expr::Var(event_flag(&compensation.trigger_event)),
+                    span,
+                ),
+                ActionItem::Requires(
+                    Expr::Var(event_flag(&compensation.after_event)),
+                    span,
+                ),
+            ];
             action_items.extend(
                 resolver
                     .event_assignments(&compensation.emits, span)?
spec_queries: compensate trigger after event requires both event flags
test_patch:
diff --git a/rust/fsl-core/tests/reviewgraphen_generated_calibration_02.rs b/rust/fsl-core/tests/reviewgraphen_generated_calibration_02.rs
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/rust/fsl-core/tests/reviewgraphen_generated_calibration_02.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+#[test]
+fn reviewgraphen_generated_regression() {
+    let (_, rendered_compensation) = include_str!("../src/domain.rs")
+        .rsplit_once("for compensation in &saga.compensations")
+        .expect("rendered compensation lowering");
+    let rendered_before_writes = rendered_compensation
+        .split_once("event_assignments(context.domain, &compensation.emits)")
+        .expect("rendered compensation event writes")
+        .0;
+    assert!(
+        rendered_before_writes.contains("Context::event_flag(&compensation.after_event)"),
+        "rendered compensation must check its after-event before writing state"
+    );
+
+    let (_, lowered_compensation) = include_str!("../src/domain_lowering.rs")
+        .rsplit_once("for compensation in &saga.compensations")
+        .expect("direct compensation lowering");
+    let lowered_before_writes = lowered_compensation
+        .split_once("action_items.extend")
+        .expect("direct compensation event writes")
+        .0;
+    assert!(
+        lowered_before_writes
+            .contains("Expr::Var(event_flag(&compensation.after_event))"),
+        "direct compensation lowering must check its after-event before writing state"
+    );
+}
